integrity: Analytical determinant proof, signed minor tables, exact rational independent checker; no authorship or independent external validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the normalized family \(h=e_1-ae_2-be_3\) with \(a,b\ge0\) and its Cartesian-cube lifts; does not classify all zonoids or all directions. The Fradelizi et al. manuscript had abstract-level access only; unindexed prior overlap remains possible. Rational tests supplement but do not prove the continuous claim.
title: Exact two-parameter directional phase diagram for a zonotope log-submodularity counterexample
